title: _updatePhUSDEmissionRate truncates phUSDPerSecond to zero for small totalStaked at low APY, silently disabling phUSD emission

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-10 'Zero APY operation is supported and expected'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-10 covers configured zero APY. This finding is silent truncation at LOW (not zero) APY × small totalStaked — a precision defect at a different boundary.
